_meta.purpose: The scoring and kill rules enforced by tools/validate_concept.py. Gates are ordered; a concept that fails a hard gate is killed, not repaired by loosening the gate.
_meta.calibration: Target gate_pass_rate of 20-40%. If the validator passes almost everything, the validator is broken, not the batch.

checks.rule: demand.query is a non-empty string of 2-6 words
demand.query is not a single generic noun and is not in the generic_noun_denylist
demand.adjacent has at least 8 distinct phrases
demand.evidence is one of the allowed evidence types
demand.est_monthly_volume >= 1000, OR the adjacent long-tail phrases carry documented volume summing to >= 1000, OR evidence type is 'qualitative' with a stated source
demand.competition is not 'high' unless angle.differentiator is populated
angle.audience is specific - not 'everyone', not a bare demographic bucket
angle.insider_vocab has at least 3 entries drawn from the target community's own language
angle.emotional_job is exactly one of the allowed values
angle.specificity_rung >= 2 on the niche's specificity ladder
visual.style_id (poster) or visual.layout_id (tshirt) resolves to a real entry in the library
visual.palette has 1-6 hex values, or resolves to a palette id
composition, typography and texture are all non-empty
visual.avoid has at least 3 negative constraints
visual.reads_at_250px_via names what carries the design at thumbnail size
render prompt contains none of the slop_padding_terms
at most 3 type families named
production.aspect_ratio is in the target platform's allowed set
production.px meets or exceeds the platform minimum
apparel products declare background 'transparent'
production.edge_buffer_px >= platform minimum where the platform sets one
apparel concepts declare garment_safe as 'both', or supply two exports
title length within the platform's min/max
tag count equals the platform's slot count exactly
every tag within the platform's per-tag character limit
at least 60% of tags are multi-word phrases
no tag's token set is a subset of the title's token set
description does not contain the title verbatim
decor-market poster titles contain a colour word
gift-intent concepts contain a relationship word in the title
no shipped text matches any R4 pattern in ip_risk_rules.json
ip.tier is set and is not R4
ip.screened_against[] is populated for tiers R1 and R2
tier R3 concepts declare a verified open-access source
(style_id|layout_id, palette_id, subject_lemma) is unique across the batch and the live catalogue
normalised title trigram overlap <= 0.6 against every existing concept
colourways, garment colours and sizes are product options, never separate concepts
